n: N is a common nonmetallic element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless inert diatomic gas.

N can also mean a unit of force equal to the force that imparts an acceleration of 1 m/sec/sec to a mass of 1 kilogram.
N means the same as nitrogen or atomic number 7 or north.
n'djamena: N'Djamena is the capital and largest city of Chad.

n-type semiconductor: A n-type semiconductor is a semiconductor in which electrical conduction is due chiefly to the movement of electrons.
